method: Entire production frequency hub evaluated in fresh Node VMs with controlled minimal DOM/FR seams; real public controller operations and mirrors exercise library-message ownership and generic-message retention.
limitations: No browser rendering, native event timing, user activation, physical audio or live dhikr execution is claimed.
External native Stop/tuning and global hold changes are explicit controlled dependency changes followed by the actual hub mirror.

results.name: Owned playing notice survives unchanged mirrors and volume edits, then clears on common Stop
An external native frequency Stop clears the library notice on the next actual mirror
A global hold change removes the owned playing claim while retaining the frequency graph
A library selection made under hold clears its paused instruction after Resume without a new start
Manual native carrier tuning retires only the owned library message and keeps playing
Manual native beat tuning retires the owned library message independently of the carrier
A later generic preset instruction relinquishes library ownership and survives Stop or manual tuning
